adjusted_prescription: To help the agent navigate safely from the start to the goal while avoiding fire tiles, it is important to provide a demonstration that follows the left-edge corridor. This demonstration should show the agent staying along the left border of the grid, moving down the left column, then along the bottom row, and finally up the right column to reach the goal without stepping on any fire tiles. Including variations with different randomized fire placements will help the agent learn that always choosing perimeter paths—especially the left edge—keeps it safely away from fires. Showing examples where the agent successfully reaches the goal by following these edges reinforces how to generalize fire avoidance. This approach contrasts with paths near central fire tiles and emphasizes the safety and reliability of sticking to the perimeter corridors.
